name: Gradient-Constrained Load Balancing Loss
definition: A loss function to minimize thread idle periods during parallel pixel rendering by constraining the number of Gaussians per pixel, adapted to scene complexity via gradient weighting.
summary: Gradient-Constrained Load Balancing Loss optimizes 3D Gaussian Splatting efficiency by balancing pixel workload based on local image gradients, preserving fidelity in complex regions while reducing redundancy in simple areas.
